candidate.answerReason: For example, lateral edge BC is perpendicular to BA and BF because the adjoining faces are rectangles. BA and BF intersect at B in base plane ABFE, so BC is perpendicular to that plane.

methods.label: Two intersecting base edges
methods.explanation: The lateral edge is perpendicular to two intersecting edges of the base, so it is perpendicular to the base.
methods.levelReason: Uses rectangle right angles and the standard two-intersecting-lines criterion for line-plane perpendicularity.
